name: skillpass-care-pilot
description: Pilot scaffold for portable service coverage on CKB-style live Cell ownership.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @skillpass/api" "npm run dev -w @skillpass/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @skillpass/shared && npm run build -w @skillpass/core && npm run build -w @skillpass/ckb-adapter && npm run build -w @skillpass/provider-sdk && npm run build -w @skillpass/config
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @skillpass/api && npm run build -w @skillpass/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:apps
